summary.pt: Um jogo sobre a vida em comunidade e as interações entre colegas de quarto.
summary.en: A game about communal living and the interactions between roommates.

pt: You are roommates who just moved in together and are decorating your home.
In each of the 3 rounds, you are given pairs of items you don’t want in the house. For each pair, write a one-word clue that connects them.
Once all clues are written, try to match each clue to the correct pair of items.
The single item left without a matching clue is kept in the house.
Work together to earn happiness points by making the correct matches. The house needs at least 60% of happiness to be a good place to live.
